meta.instructions: Fill in one object per employee under 'entries', following the 'example' rows below as a pattern. Delete the example rows before handing this back for import. Field notes: name/phone/role are REQUIRED (matches src/app/api/employees/create/route.js's own validation) — everything else is optional and can be omitted entirely from a row rather than left blank.
meta.source: REPLACE with wherever this data actually comes from (e.g. 'HR staff-list.xlsx')

fieldNotes.name: REQUIRED. Full name.
fieldNotes.phone: REQUIRED. Digits only, as a string (e.g. "9876543210") — not a number, so a leading 0 or a long number never gets silently truncated/rounded.
fieldNotes.role: REQUIRED. Must be exactly one of roleOptions above — case-sensitive.
fieldNotes.isactive: Optional, defaults to true if omitted. Set false only for an employee being entered as already inactive/former staff.
fieldNotes.salaryStructure: Optional. If given, provide baseSalary (number), salaryType (one of salaryTypeOptions, defaults to "Monthly"), and effectiveFrom ("YYYY-MM-DD", defaults to today). Omit the whole object if this employee's base pay isn't being tracked.
fieldNotes.incentiveRate: Optional. The usual per-patient incentive amount for this employee — defaults to 0 if omitted. Only meaningful for Agent/Counsellor roles in practice, but not enforced.
